production_delta: Two lines: require event_id to be a nonempty exact str before SQL; no decision_id restriction or stored-data migration.

before.meaning: Valid control passes. Signed int/bool receipts wrongly close the event while the auditor reports INVALID_RECEIPT_RECORD.

after.meaning: Valid string accepted; int/bool rejected before SQL with unchanged complete logical store hash.

limits: Authentic public test signer and correct computed score; no cryptographic break is alleged.
No new decision_id restriction; the existing registered-decision contract is preserved.
Rejecting future malformed receipts does not repair invalid records already stored.
Three shared-admission-path cases only; no independent algorithm comparison or business action.
